Maya CS: Quick sync — HelioHealth onboarding just wrapped. They surfaced 3 product asks and 1 urgent renewal signal.

Jo Support: What are the asks?

Maya CS: Short list from the call:
- per-route cost visibility (toggle/report grouped by account/team)
- exportable session logs with configurable redaction (legal requests)
- batching controls in the console (ops wants batch-size granularity)

Maya CS: Renewal flag: pilot license ends in ~4 weeks. Customer said they're nervous about unknown per-route charges — could block renewal.

Ravi AE: Noted. Did they rank priorities on their side?

Maya CS: Yes — priority order from HelioOps/Security/Infra: 1) per-route cost visibility, 2) logs export with redaction, 3) batching controls. They asked for an ETA window rather than a firm date.

Ethan PM: @Maya can you paste the exact one-liners we should include in intake?

Maya CS: Verbatim snippets from stakeholders:
"we need a toggle to see cost per endpoint per team" — HelioOps
"legal needs an export we can run through DLP" — HelioSecurity
"ops wants control over batch sizes per workload" — HelioInfra

Jo Support: I'll attach the session recording + summarized notes to Zendesk ticket #2241.

Maya CS: I'll add this to the CS intake board and mark the account as a renewal risk. Suggestion: propose a lightweight cost dashboard MVP that surfaces per-route spend + a clear export while we scope the other asks.

Ethan PM: OK — I'll scope an MVP for the cost dashboard and check dev bandwidth. @Ravi can you own stakeholder follow-up?

Ravi AE: Yep. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up with Helio for next week and send the invite.

OnboardBot: Transcript uploaded: /shared/onboard/helio-2990011222.wav :white_check_mark:

Maya CS: Thanks — tagging for prioritization lane: ops-dashboard (cost) -> P0, logs export -> P1, batching controls -> P2. :thumbsup:
